reply: Thank you for telling us that you received login and shipping emails for an account you never opened, and that you could not confirm whether your identity was used. We understand how confusing and worrying this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please keep the emails, review your credit reports for accounts you do not recognize, and only share ID documents through the company's official app or website. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a written dispute about an account on your credit file has not received a response or correction. We understand your concern about the effect on your credit profile. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. You can also dispute the information directly with each credit reporting company, so please keep copies of your dispute letters and proof of the dates they were sent. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your new card account was restricted and then closed before you could use it, even after you sent the requested documents. We understand your frustration about the credit inquiry. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team. Please keep copies of the documents you sent and the closure notice, and ask in writing for the reason the account was closed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that late payment entries on your credit report appear to be inaccurate. We understand why you want them checked. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please list each entry with the account, date and why you believe it is wrong, and keep any payment records that show the payment was on time. You can also check your report for other common errors. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have not been able to use your card for long periods since opening, and that access has not been restored despite many calls. We understand how this affects your balance and the promotional offer. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team. Please keep a record of each call, any reference numbers and the letters you received about replacement cards. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that one of your $3,000.00 disputes was denied as late, even though the same documents had been used to resolve a related dispute. We understand why this seems inconsistent. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team, including when your documents were first received. Please keep the original email with the dates you sent the documents and your resubmission. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a fraud alert call was made to your father, that charges were read out during a joint call, and that unknown phone numbers were added to your account. We understand your concern about your privacy. Your complaint has been logged for review by the privacy team. Please ask in writing for the phone numbers on your account to be reviewed, and keep a record of these calls. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your dispute about a company that took your money but did not deliver the agreed work has not been resolved, despite many calls. We are sorry for the time you have spent on this. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep the contract or quote, your messages with the company and the documents you sent, and ask for a single case reference. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your statement shows an interest rate of 19.74% that differs from what you were told, and that you were asked for banking details in a way that worried you. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including the rate on your account. Please do not share banking details with callers you cannot verify, and keep your statements showing the rate. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your card account was closed after a verification email went to your junk folder, despite your long payment history. We understand how upsetting this was. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team. Card issuers can generally close accounts without notice, but you can ask what options remain. Please keep the email and a note of your call. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that an automatic payment was taken from your bank account after you cancelled autopay, overdrawing your account for the second time. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep the email confirming you were unenrolled, and tell both the card company and your bank in writing that you no longer authorize automatic payments. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your dispute was closed after you did not receive a letter, and that the packet you then sent, as advised by phone, was rejected as late. We understand why this feels unfair. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team, including the call where you were told to send the packet. Please keep proof of the mailing date and a note of that call. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that several transactions were declined, that you asked to close your account, and that your points were removed. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including the points balance at the time of closure. Please keep the dates of the declined transactions and your closure request. Card issuers may close accounts, but the review will look at the points. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $630.00 internet payment item on your card statement has not been explained, and that you were sent between the card company and your bank. We understand how frustrating that is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please follow the statement instructions for reporting a billing error in writing, using the address listed for disputes, and keep a copy. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you asked to close your card when the annual fee posted, had to pay the full $99.00 fee, and still see the card as active online. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including the closure and the fee. Please send a written billing error notice about the fee and ask for written confirmation that the account is closed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that an account opened through identity theft is still reported as valid, despite your disputes and Identity Theft Report. We understand the harm this is doing to your credit. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. You can also dispute the account with each credit reporting company, so please send copies of your Identity Theft Report and keep proof of each dispute. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that you received collection calls about a store card you never opened, and that a claim has been opened to close it. We understand how unsettling this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please ask the caller in writing for the validation details of the debt, keep the claim paperwork, and consider reporting the identity theft as suggested. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you applied online for a 24-month 0% introductory offer, but your agreement shows 18 months, and that you were asked for a mailer that does not exist. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including the online offer at the time of your application. Please keep any screenshots or emails about the offer. The card issuer must tell you how long the introductory rate lasts. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your dispute about a $250.00 online charge from a company you believe is a scam was denied, and that it has been hard to get help in your language. We are sorry for the difficulty. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep the order details, any information you found about the merchant, and your dispute notices, and ask whether the dispute can be reopened by mail. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your $6,100.00 hotel dispute was denied twice, even though you documented unsafe conditions during your stay. We are sorry for the effect on your health and belongings. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team, including the evidence you submitted. Please keep the photographs, the physician's notes and proof that you told the hotel during your stay. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your $520.00 dispute was denied even though the store confirmed in writing that your item was released to someone else. We understand why you disagree with the decision. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team, including the merchant's written statement. Please keep that statement, your order confirmation and the dispute letters together. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your store card was closed for a dishonored payment, even though your bank records show no returned payment and the late fee was reversed. We understand your concern about your credit report. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including the reporting. Please keep your bank records and the fee reversal, and check your credit reports for errors. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that rent for an apartment you no longer live in was charged to your benefits card without permission, and that your dispute has not succeeded. We understand how difficult this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please write down when you withdrew your permission and how, and keep any records showing you moved out. Asking for the dispute decision in writing will also help. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were told by phone that the sign-up bonus still applied, but you did not receive it after meeting the spending requirement. We understand your frustration that a different call was reviewed. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including the correct call date and number. Please keep the application reference number and your spending records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a moving company kept your deposit even though it never arrived and you cancelled in writing, and that your dispute was denied twice. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team, including how the dispute was classified. Please keep the estimate, your written cancellation and any messages about the missed pickup. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that 18 late fees were charged over time even though your account was on AutoPay, and that you received no notice of a problem. We understand your concern about the interest added as a result. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including the AutoPay history. Please keep your statements showing each fee and payment date, and check that AutoPay is set correctly going forward. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were charged $98.00 instead of $49.00, that only part was returned, and that a temporary credit was later reversed without the letter you were told to expect. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep the merchant's emails and the dispute dates, and ask in writing for the outcome letter and the documents received. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your account balance is about $500.00 lower than your transaction history supports, and that you have not been shown the transaction behind it. We understand why you want this reconciled. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please keep screenshots of your balance and transaction history, and ask in writing for the transaction details that explain the difference. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you disputed a $50.00 expedited shipping charge for a document that was never shipped, and that the charge remained after six months. We understand your frustration with the time taken. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep your cancellation notice and the outcome letter, and ask in writing for details of how the dispute was investigated. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your dispute was closed for missing information you had already provided by phone, and that you were later told it would be reopened. We understand how frustrating the dropped calls have been. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team, including the reopened claim. Please keep a note of each call date and the merchant's message about the refund. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
